title: Canyon Hills Golf Course
specs: Known to have the best greens in the state
All players are required to have their own set of clubs
includes: Rental carts, pull carts, rental clubs, club repair
Pro shop and snack bar access
blurb: Guests play golf on a traditional 18-hole course with bent greens and blue fairways, tees, and rough. The course offers rental carts, pull carts, rental clubs, and club repair. Facilities include a driving range, putting green, and snack bar.
extraNote: Carts are for patrons playing golf first; rider availability at pro shop discretion · No pets allowed · Singles booking tee times online are not guaranteed and may be moved; must share carts on busy days · Maximum time allowed: 9 holes in 2 hours, 18 holes in 4 hours · March 1 – December 31
